content: Timefold supports multiple distinct @PlanningEntity classes coexisting in one @PlanningSolution, each with independent @PlanningVariable/@PlanningListVariable fields, registered via separate @PlanningEntityCollectionProperty-annotated lists. This is baseline OptaPlanner/Timefold modeling capability, documented consistently from 0.8.x docs through latest, with no changelog entries indicating it changed around 1.16.0.
